symbols.name: OperationSummaryDocumentTransformer
symbols.summary: Enhances operation documentation with automatically generated summaries and descriptions.
symbols.remarks: This transformer automatically generates clear, user-friendly summaries for API operations based on their operation IDs and path information. It respects existing summaries set via XML documentation but fills in gaps for endpoints that lack documentation. Key responsibilities: Generates summaries from operation IDs if not already documentedConverts HTTP method names (Get, Post, Put, Delete, Patch) to readable descriptionsPreserves existing XML documentation summariesImproves API usability and self-discovery in documentation tools Example transformations: GetById → "Get a single item by its identifier"CreateUser → "Create a new user"UpdateProfile → "Update an existing profile"DeleteItem → "Delete the specified item"PatchSettings → "Partially update settings"

symbols.name: TransformAsync(OpenApiOperation, OpenApiOperationTransformerContext, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Transforms the OpenAPI operation to add or enhance its summary.
symbols.remarks: This method: Checks if the operation already has a summary from XML documentationIf no summary exists, extracts the operation ID or pathGenerates a human-readable summary based on the operation detailsApplies the generated summary to the operation Priority order: Existing summary from XML documentation (highest priority)Generated summary from operation ID or path (fallback)
